ambiguities: The narrator mentions a marriage overture arranged by the duc de Guermantes on behalf of a niece's family who are 'résignés... à une semblable mésalliance' (resigned to the unequal match), which could suggest either a social elevation (being sought by high nobility) or a status reminder (being deemed an unequal match). The narrator explicitly declines to narrate the episode ('Je ne dirai rien de...'), leaving it too underdeveloped and mixed to score as a distinct event for either the duc de Guermantes or le narrateur.
